svg.title: Blueprints Talk — from drawings to verifiable answers
svg.desc: Drawing readers produce a cached Scene. A question planner produces a cached QueryPlan. An exact executor combines them. Answers with confidence at least 0.50 proceed to the evidence viewer; missing or low-confidence answers escalate to a tool-using Nemotron agent. Gemini reads drawings without a working builder and provides the agent fallback. Human corrections rerun the same executor without a model call. This is a logical architecture overview of the current repository.
svg.text: Escalate only when the fast path needs help.
Parsers and vision share the same entity contract.
The executor owns all arithmetic and evidence IDs.
Unsupported plans and reader failures also escalate.
If the drawing cannot support an answer, surface why.
